ja: Figure-rise Standard ピッコロがパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！
• パワーアップしたマッスルビルドシステムにより、ピッコロの特徴的な腕の筋肉を成形色のみで再現！
• さらに、可動もパワーアップ！肩と腕の引き出し関節により腕組みポーズも可能に！
• ピッコロの代名詞マントとターバンが付属し、様々なシーンのピッコロが楽しめる！
• 他のキャラクターと組み合わせて遊びの幅がさらに広がる新パーツ「ドラマティックパーツ」には「超サイヤ人 孫悟飯」の頭髪パーツが付属！師弟コンビの劇中シーンが再現可能に！
• エフェクトパーツはピッコロの必殺技「魔貫光殺砲」が付属！
en: Figure-rise Standard Piccolo is now available with a renewed package! !
• With the powered-up muscle build system, Piccolo's characteristic arm muscles are reproduced using only molded colors!
• In addition, the movement is powered up! The arms can be posed with folded arms thanks to the pull-out joints in the shoulders and arms!
• Piccolo's signature cloak and turban are included, so you can enjoy Piccolo in various scenes!

• New parts "Dramatic Parts " that can be combined with other characters to further expand the range of play include " Super Saiyan Son Gohan" hair parts! Scenes from the play of the teacher-pupil duo can now be recreated!
• Effect parts include Piccolo's special move "Makan Kosatsuhou"!

ja: 必殺技エフェクト（魔貫光殺砲）×1
表情パーツ3種（平常、怒り、ターバン着用（平常））×各1
手首パーツ2種（左右握り手、魔貫光殺砲用右手）×各1
超サイヤ人孫悟飯用　頭髪パーツ×1
en: Special move effect (Magical light killing gun) x 1
3 types of facial expression parts (normal, angry, wearing turban (normal)) x 1 each
2 types of wrist parts (left and right gripping hands, right hand for Makankosatsu gun) x 1 each
Hair parts for Super Saiyan Son Gohan x 1
